Nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to share your results at the end.</p><div class="ra-btns"><button class="ra-btn" type="button" data-go="ready">Start with readiness</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-go="vendor">Skip to the vendor assessment</button><span id="ra-resume" style="display:none"><span class="ra-link" role="button" tabindex="0" data-act="clear">Clear saved answers and start over</span></span></div></section><!-- READINESS --><section class="ra-screen" id="ra-ready" aria-labelledby="ra-ready-h"><span class="ra-link ra-back" role="button" tabindex="0" data-nav="intro">\u2190 Back to start</span><div class="ra-eyebrow">Part 1 of 2 \xB7 readiness</div><h2 id="ra-ready-h" style="margin-top:8px">Score your agency on eight questions</h2><p class="ra-lead">Pick the answer closest to where your agency is today, not where you plan to be. Answer for one problem you would use AI for.</p><div class="ra-prog"><div class="ra-prog-row"><span>Readiness</span><span id="ra-rp-t">0 of 8</span></div><div class="ra-prog-bar"><i id="ra-rp"></i></div></div><div id="ra-rq"></div><div class="ra-btns"><button class="ra-btn" type="button" data-act="rdone">See my readiness</button><span class="ra-err" id="ra-rerr" role="alert">Answer every question to see your score. The unanswered ones are outlined.</span></div></section><!-- READINESS RESULT --><section class="ra-screen" id="ra-rres" aria-labelledby="ra-rres-h" tabindex="-1"><div class="ra-eyebrow">Part 1 of 2 \xB7 your readiness</div><h2 id="ra-rres-h" style="margin-top:8px">Your readiness</h2><div class="ra-score"><div class="ra-big" id="ra-rt">0<small> / 24</small></div><div><div class="lab">Readiness tier</div><h3 id="ra-rtier"></h3><p id="ra-rmsg"></p></div></div><div class="ra-bands"><div class="b0" style="width:41.67%">Not ready \xB7 0 to 9</div><div class="b1" style="width:33.33%">Partially ready \xB7 10 to 17</div><div class="b2" style="width:25%">Ready \xB7 18 to 24</div></div><div class="ra-marker"><i id="ra-rmark"></i></div><div class="ra-card"><h3>Score by dimension</h3><div class="ra-key" aria-label="Color key"><span style="--lc:var(--coral)">0 or 1 \xB7 not ready</span><span style="--lc:var(--blue)">2 \xB7 partially ready</span><span style="--lc:var(--mint)">3 \xB7 ready</span></div><div class="ra-dims" id="ra-rdims"></div></div><div class="ra-card"><h3>Your two weakest dimensions</h3><p class="ra-muted" style="margin-top:4px">Start here. Each one is something you can move before a vendor conversation.</p><div class="ra-acts" id="ra-racts"></div></div><div class="ra-btns" id="ra-rnext"></div><div class="ra-leadslot" data-ctx="ready"></div></section><!-- VENDOR --><section class="ra-screen" id="ra-vendor" aria-labelledby="ra-vendor-h"><span class="ra-link ra-back" role="button" tabindex="0" data-nav="ready">\u2190 Back to readiness</span><div class="ra-eyebrow">Part 2 of 2 \xB7 vendor</div><h2 id="ra-vendor-h" style="margin-top:8px">Score a vendor from what they put in writing</h2><p class="ra-lead">Score 0 to 3 from documents: the quote, contract, data addendum, security materials and references. A claim with nothing behind it scores as unclear.</p><div class="ra-card"><label class="ra-note" style="margin-top:0"><span>Vendor or product (optional)</span><input type="text" id="ra-vname" maxlength="80" placeholder="For your report, e.g. the product name"></label><h3 style="margin-top:22px">Set the risk tier first</h3><p class="ra-muted" style="margin-top:4px">The tier changes which scores are disqualifying. Pick the highest that applies to how you would use this tool.</p><div class="ra-tiers" id="ra-tiers" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Risk tier"></div><p style="margin-top:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)">At Elevated or High, a low score on security and privacy disqualifies the vendor, whatever the total.</p></div><div class="ra-prog"><div class="ra-prog-row"><span>Vendor</span><span id="ra-vp-t">0 of 14</span></div><div class="ra-prog-bar"><i id="ra-vp"></i></div></div><div id="ra-vq"></div><div class="ra-btns"><button class="ra-btn" type="button" data-act="vdone">See the vendor result</button><span class="ra-err" id="ra-verr" role="alert">Set the risk tier and answer every question. The missing ones are outlined.</span></div></section><!-- VENDOR RESULT --><section class="ra-screen" id="ra-vres" aria-labelledby="ra-vres-h" tabindex="-1"><div class="ra-eyebrow">Part 2 of 2 \xB7 vendor result</div><h2 id="ra-vres-h" style="margin-top:8px">Vendor result</h2><div class="ra-score"><div class="ra-big" id="ra-vt">0<small> / 42</small></div><div><div class="lab" id="ra-vlab">Vendor score</div><h3 id="ra-vband"></h3><p id="ra-vmsg"></p></div></div><div class="ra-bands"><div class="b0" style="width:35.7%">Major red flags \xB7 0 to 14</div><div class="b1" style="width:33.3%">Meaningful gaps \xB7 15 to 28</div><div class="b2" style="width:31%">Strong fit \xB7 29 to 42</div></div><div class="ra-marker"><i id="ra-vmark"></i></div><div id="ra-gate"></div><div class="ra-card"><h3>Score by category</h3><div class="ra-key" aria-label="Color key"><span style="--lc:var(--coral)">Averages 0 to 1 \xB7 major gaps</span><span style="--lc:var(--blue)">About 2 \xB7 some gaps</span><span style="--lc:var(--mint)">About 3 \xB7 strong</span></div><div class="ra-dims" id="ra-vdims"></div></div><div class="ra-card"><h3>Still open with this vendor</h3><p class="ra-muted" style="margin-top:4px">Every question scored 0 or 1. Ask for each in writing before you sign.</p><ul class="ra-list" id="ra-vopen" style="margin-top:8px"></ul></div><div class="ra-btns"><button class="ra-btn" type="button" data-act="print">Print or save as PDF</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="download">Download results</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="another">Score another vendor</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-go="vendor">Change my answers</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-nav="ready">Back to readiness</button></div><div class="ra-leadslot" data-ctx="vendor"></div></section><!-- LEAD BOX (moved into the active result screen) --><aside class="ra-lead-box" id="ra-leadbox" aria-labelledby="ra-lead-h"><div><div class="ra-eyebrow" style="color:var(--blueInk)">Optional</div><h3 id="ra-lead-h" style="margin-top:6px">Get resources matched to your results</h3><p style="margin-top:10px">Share your scores with PubHealth Futures and we'll send you tools and examples for your two weakest areas: templates, contract language and what peer agencies did.</p><p class="ra-fine" style="margin-top:12px">Your scores also help us see where public health stands on AI readiness. We report only in aggregate and never share or sell your details.</p></div><form class="ra-form" id="ra-form" novalidate><div class="ra-thanks" id="ra-thanks" role="status" tabindex="-1"><b>Thanks, it's on its way to us.</b><br>Look for an email from connect@pubhealthfutures.org.</div><label><span>Name</span><input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" required></label><label><span>Work email</span><input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required></label><label><span>Agency or organization</span><input type="text" name="org" autocomplete="organization"></label><label><span>Role (optional)</span><input type="text" name="role" autocomplete="organization-title"></label><label class="ra-check"><input type="checkbox" name="talk" value="yes"><span>I'm open to a short call to talk through my agency's readiness.</span></label><div class="ra-hp" aria-hidden="true"><label>Leave blank<input type="text" name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label></div><div><button class="ra-btn" type="submit" id="ra-send">Send my results</button></div><p class="ra-err" id="ra-ferr" role="alert"></p></form></aside></div></main><div class="ra-sheet" id="ra-sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="ra-sheet-h"><div class="ra-sheet-in"><div class="ra-sheet-bar"><b id="ra-sheet-h" style="font:600 20px/1.2 var(--serif);color:var(--ink)">Your results report</b><div class="ra-btns"><button class="ra-btn" type="button" data-act="download">Download report</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="copy">Copy as text</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="closesheet">Close</button></div><p class="ra-sheet-msg">This page can't open the print window here (some previews and website builders block it). Download the report and open it to print or save as PDF, or copy it into an email or document. <span class="ra-sheet-ok" id="ra-sheet-ok" role="status"></span></p></div><div class="ra-rep" id="ra-rep"></div></div></div><footer class="ra-foot"><div class="ra-wrap">PubHealth Futures \xB7 Accelerating Public Health with Responsible AI \xB7 <a class="ra-link" href="mailto:connect@pubhealthfutures.org">connect@pubhealthfutures.org</a><br>This self-assessment supports decisions; it does not replace your agency's procurement, legal or privacy review.</div></footer></div><script>
(function(){
/* ============ SETTINGS: edit these ============ */
var CONFIG = {
  /* Where lead submissions go. Pick one:
     'mailto'     : works with no setup; opens the person's email app with results addressed to you (they press Send)
     'formspree'  : set endpoint to your Formspree URL, e.g. https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz
     'googleform' : set endpoint to https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/<FORM_ID>/formResponse and fill in entries below */
  leadMode: 'formspree',
  endpoint: 'https://formspree.io/f/mkjozkyg',
  leadEmail: 'connect@pubhealthfutures.org',
  /* Google Form only: the entry.NNNN id for each question (from "Get pre-filled link") */
  entries: { name:'', email:'', org:'', role:'', talk:'', readiness:'', vendor:'', summary:'' },
  helpEmailSubject: 'Help getting ready for AI'
};
/* ============================================== */

var root=document.getElementById('phf-ra');
function $(s,c){return (c||root).querySelector(s)}
function $$(s,c){return Array.prototype.slice.call((c||root).querySelectorAll(s))}
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}

var RQ=[
 ['Problem','What specific problem are you trying to solve with AI?',['We have a documented, measurable workflow pain point','We have a general area of interest but haven\u2019t scoped it','We\u2019re exploring AI broadly to see where it fits','Leadership wants us to \u201Cdo AI\u201D'],
  'Write a four-part problem statement','Name the workflow, how often it happens and how it is done today, what it costs in hours, dollars, risk or delay, and how you would know it improved in 90 days.'],
 ['AI fit','Have you tested whether AI is actually the right solution?',['Yes, assessed against speed, scale, scope, sophistication, and considered non-AI alternatives','Discussed internally but not formally evaluated','We assume AI is the answer because it\u2019s the tool available','We haven\u2019t considered alternatives'],
  'Test the fit before the tool','Ask which constraint you actually have: speed, scale, scope or sophistication. If none, name one non-AI fix (a form, a workflow change, a staff role) and compare.'],
 ['Champion','Who on your team will champion this work?',['Named internal champion with protected time','Someone interested, capacity uncertain','Leadership interested, no one owns it yet','No one specific; we expect it to emerge'],
  'Name an owner with protected time','Put one name on this work and protect part of their week for it in writing. Interest without time stalls at the pilot.'],
 ['IT partnership','Is your IT department aware of and engaged in this work?',['IT is at the table from the beginning as a partner','IT knows generally but isn\u2019t actively involved','We plan to loop IT in when we have something concrete','IT hasn\u2019t been part of the conversation'],
  'Bring IT in now, as a partner','Invite IT to the first scoping conversation, not the final review. Ask what would make them say no: those are your requirements.'],
 ['Data','How well do you understand the data you\u2019d feed into an AI tool?',['Inventoried, quality assessed, governance documented','We know where it lives, no quality or governance work done','The data exists somewhere but we\u2019d need to find it','No clear picture of our data assets'],
  'Inventory the data the tool would touch','Where it lives, its quality, who governs it and which agreements cover this use. Vendors will ask; your answers set the risk tier.'],
 ['AI literacy','What\u2019s your team\u2019s baseline AI literacy?',['Structured AI training completed; comfortable with core concepts','A few self-taught; most haven\u2019t engaged directly','People have tried chatbots but no formal grounding','No AI-focused conversations or training'],
  'Build shared AI literacy first','Get the core team through structured AI fundamentals before vendor demos, so the room can tell a capability from a claim.'],
 ['Funding and procurement','Do you have a clear path for funding and procurement?',['Budget identified, procurement process clear for AI tools','Budget exists, procurement path unclear for AI specifically','We\u2019d need to find funding before moving forward','No budget line or procurement clarity'],
  'Find the money and the path','Identify a budget line beyond the pilot, and ask procurement how an AI tool would be bought before a vendor names a price.'],
 ['Governance','Does your agency have AI governance or guardrails in place?',['Documented AI policy and risk-tier framework','IT and privacy policies that cover AI implicitly','Policy in development, nothing adopted','No AI-specific governance exists'],
  'Adopt a risk-tier framework','Start simple: Low, Moderate, Elevated and High, tied to the data each use touches, with what each tier requires before approval.']
];
var TIERS=[
 ['Low','Learning, public content, administrative support. No confidential data.'],
 ['Moderate','Policy drafting, research synthesis, code generation. De-identified or public data.'],
 ['Elevated','Synthetic data, anonymized scenarios, chatbots. Patterns from sensitive data.'],
 ['High','Clinical support, predictive analytics, PHI processing. Direct PHI or PII.']
];
var VQ=[
 ['Security and privacy',[
  ['Is it clear how the vendor uses your data, including for model training?',['Documented in contract with opt-out rights','Disclosed verbally or in marketing, not in contract','Vague or unclear answers','Haven\u2019t asked / don\u2019t know'],'Data use and training'],
  ['What are the vendor\u2019s security practices for PHI or PII?',['HIPAA BAA in place, documented controls, third-party audits','HIPAA-compliant claim, details unclear','Some security mentions, no BAA','Not addressed / don\u2019t know'],'Security for PHI or PII']]],
 ['Bias and fairness',[
  ['Has the vendor documented bias testing across demographics relevant to your population?',['Yes, bias audit reports with demographic breakdowns','Claims equity but no documentation','Acknowledges it as a concern, no testing','Not addressed / don\u2019t know'],'Bias testing'],
  ['How does performance vary across populations this tool will serve?',['Vendor provides subgroup performance data for our populations','Aggregate performance only','No performance data provided','Haven\u2019t asked'],'Subgroup performance']]],
 ['Evidence and efficacy',[
  ['Has this tool been deployed in similar public health settings with published outcomes?',['Peer-reviewed or case-studied in public health, references available','Deployed in public health, outcomes vendor-reported only','Deployed in healthcare but not public health','No verifiable deployment evidence'],'Public health deployment'],
  ['How will you measure whether this tool is working?',['Vendor helped define goal-appropriate KPIs tied to our outcomes','Standard vendor metrics that partially match our goals','Success metrics are fuzzy or vendor-defined','No success metrics defined'],'Success measures']]],
 ['Integration and usability',[
  ['How well does this tool integrate with your existing systems?',['Confirmed integrations with our stack, IT has vetted','Standard integrations claimed, IT hasn\u2019t vetted','Integration possible but requires custom work','Don\u2019t know / haven\u2019t evaluated'],'Integration'],
  ['What\u2019s the learning curve and ongoing support model?',['Structured onboarding, named support, defined SLAs','Documentation provided, ticket-based support','Self-service with limited support','Unclear'],'Support model']]],
 ['Vendor and sustainability',[
  ['What\u2019s the vendor\u2019s track record and financial stability?',['Established, public health references, financial transparency','Growing company with some references','Early stage or first public health deployment','Don\u2019t know'],'Track record and stability'],
  ['What\u2019s your exit plan? Can you export your data and walk away?',['Data portability guaranteed contractually in a defined format','Export possible with vendor involvement','Terms unclear','No exit provisions'],'Exit and data portability']]],
 ['Equity and accessibility',[
  ['Does the tool support the languages and accessibility needs of your population?',['Multiple relevant languages, ADA compliant, cultural validation','Some language and accessibility support','English only, basic accessibility','Not addressed'],'Language and accessibility'],
  ['Can the tool be tailored to your community context?',['Content and configuration adaptable, vendor supports customization','Some configurability, limited','One-size-fits-all, no adaptation','Don\u2019t know'],'Configurability']]],
 ['Knowledge transfer',[
  ['How will the vendor help you build internal capacity?',['Knowledge transfer, training, handover plan contractually included','Some training offered, no sustainability plan','Training available at additional cost','No knowledge transfer plan'],'Knowledge transfer']]],
 ['Cost structure',[
  ['Is the total cost of ownership known, and is the pricing durable?',['Full total cost quoted or estimated (license, implementation, integration, security review, staff time, exit) with a renewal estimate in writing','License and implementation quoted, other lines unestimated','License only, or promotional pricing with no renewal estimate','Haven\u2019t asked'],'Total cost and renewal pricing']]]
];
var VFLAT=[];VQ.forEach(function(c,ci){c[1].forEach(function(q){VFLAT.push({cat:c[0],ci:ci,q:q[0],o:q[1],short:q[2]})})});

/* ---------- state ---------- */
var KEY='phf-ra-v1';
var S={r:{},v:{},notes:{},tier:null,vname:'',screen:'intro',sent:false};
try{var saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null');if(saved&&typeof saved==='object'){for(var k in S){if(k in saved)S[k]=saved[k]}}}catch(e){}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}}

/* ---------- render questions ---------- */
function opts(name,o,sel){return '<div class="ra-opts">'+o.map(function(t,i){var sc=3-i;return '<label class="ra-opt"><input type="radio" name="'+name+'" value="'+sc+'"'+(sel===sc?' checked':'')+'><span class="s" aria-hidden="true">'+sc+'</span><span class="t">'+esc(t)+' <span class="ra-hp">(score '+sc+')</span></span></label>'}).join('')+'</div>'}
$('#ra-rq').innerHTML=RQ.map(function(q,i){return '<fieldset class="ra-q" id="ra-r'+i+'"><legend><span class="n">'+(i+1)+'</span>'+esc(q[1])+'</legend>'+opts('r'+i,q[2],S.r[i])+'</fieldset>'}).join('');
var vh='',last=-1;
VFLAT.forEach(function(q,i){if(q.ci!==last){vh+='<div class="ra-cat">'+esc(q.cat)+'</div>';last=q.ci}
 vh+='<fieldset class="ra-q" id="ra-v'+i+'"><legend><span class="n">Q'+(i+1)+'</span>'+esc(q.q)+'</legend>'+opts('v'+i,q.o,S.v[i])+
 '<label class="ra-note"><span>Where you found it (optional)</span><input type="text" data-note="'+i+'" maxlength="160" placeholder="e.g. contract p. 9, \xA77.3, or \u201Cnot in any document\u201D" value="'+esc(S.notes[i]||'')+'"></label></fieldset>'});
$('#ra-vq').innerHTML=vh;
$('#ra-tiers').innerHTML=TIERS.map(function(t,i){return '<label class="ra-tier'+(i>1?' hot':'')+'"><input type="radio" name="tier" value="'+i+'"'+(S.tier===i?' checked':'')+'><b>'+t[0]+'</b><p>'+esc(t[1])+'</p></label>'}).join('');
$('#ra-vname').value=S.vname||'';

root.addEventListener('change',function(e){var t=e.target;
 if(t.type==='radio'){var n=t.name;
  if(n==='tier'){S.tier=+t.value}
  else if(n[0]==='r'){S.r[n.slice(1)]=+t.value;var f=$('#ra-r'+n.slice(1));f&&f.classList.remove('miss')}
  else if(n[0]==='v'){S.v[n.slice(1)]=+t.value;var g=$('#ra-v'+n.slice(1));g&&g.classList.remove('miss')}
  prog();save()}});
root.addEventListener('input',function(e){var t=e.target;
 if(t.dataset&&t.dataset.note!==undefined){S.notes[t.dataset.note]=t.value;save()}
 if(t.id==='ra-vname'){S.vname=t.value;save()}});

function cnt(o){return Object.keys(o).filter(function(k){return typeof o[k]==='number'}).length}
function prog(){var a=cnt(S.r),b=cnt(S.v);
 $('#ra-rp').style.width=(a/8*100)+'%';$('#ra-rp-t').textContent=a+' of 8';
 $('#ra-vp').style.width=(b/14*100)+'%';$('#ra-vp-t').textContent=b+' of 14'}

/* ---------- scoring ---------- */
function rTotal(){var t=0;for(var i=0;i<8;i++)t+=S.r[i]||0;return t}
function rTier(t){return t<=9?0:t<=17?1:2}
var RT=[['Not ready','Build the foundations before you talk to vendors. Going in now lets the vendor define your problem for you. Your two weakest dimensions below are the place to start.'],
 ['Partially ready','You can talk to vendors, with your gaps in view. Close your two weakest dimensions in parallel, and score any vendor you are considering in Part 2.'],
 ['Ready','You are ready to evaluate vendors. Score the one you are considering in Part 2, and keep your weakest dimension on the agenda.']];
function weakest(){var idx=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7];idx.sort(function(a,b){return (S.r[a]||0)-(S.r[b]||0)||a-b});return idx.slice(0,2)}
function vTotal(){var t=0;for(var i=0;i<14;i++)t+=S.v[i]||0;return t}
function vBand(t){return t<=14?0:t<=28?1:2}
var VB=[['Major red flags','Do not proceed on these terms. The gaps are too wide to close with a pilot.'],
 ['Meaningful gaps','Proceed only with written commitments that close the open items below.'],
 ['Strong fit on paper','Verify each claim against documents and references before you sign.']];
function gated(){return S.tier!==null&&S.tier>=2&&((S.v[0]!=null&&S.v[0]<=1)||(S.v[1]!=null&&S.v[1]<=1))}
function catScores(){return VQ.map(function(c,ci){var s=0,m=0;VFLAT.forEach(function(q,i){if(q.ci===ci){s+=S.v[i]||0;m+=3}});return {name:c[0],s:s,m:m}})}
var COL=['var(--coral)','var(--blue)','var(--mint)'];
function bar(name,s,m){var p=Math.round(s/m*100);var a=s/m*3;var l=a<1.5?0:a<2.5?1:2;var c=COL[l];return '<div class="ra-dim l'+l+'"><span class="nm">'+esc(name)+'</span><span class="tr"><i style="width:'+Math.max(p,3)+'%;background:'+c+'"></i></span><span class="v">'+s+'/'+m+'</span></div>'}

/* ---------- results ---------- */
function showR(){var t=rTotal(),k=rTier(t),w=weakest();
 $('#ra-rt').innerHTML=t+'<small> / 24</small>';$('#ra-rtier').textContent=RT[k][0];$('#ra-rmsg').textContent=RT[k][1];
 $('#ra-rmark').style.left=(t/24*100)+'%';
 $('#ra-rdims').innerHTML=RQ.map(function(q,i){return bar(q[0],S.r[i]||0,3)}).join('');
 $('#ra-racts').innerHTML=w.map(function(i){return '<div class="ra-act"><b>'+esc(RQ[i][3])+'</b><p>'+esc(RQ[i][4])+'</p></div>'}).join('');
 var nx=k===0?
  '<a class="ra-btn coral" href="mailto:'+CONFIG.leadEmail+'?subject='+encodeURIComponent(CONFIG.helpEmailSubject)+'&body='+encodeURIComponent('Readiness score: '+t+'/24 ('+RT[k][0]+')\\nWeakest: '+w.map(function(i){return RQ[i][0]}).join(', ')+'\\n\\n')+'">We can help you get ready</a><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="print">Print or save as PDF</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="download">Download results</button><span class="ra-muted">Already talking to a vendor? <span class="ra-link" role="button" tabindex="0" data-go="vendor">Score them anyway</span></span>'
  :'<button class="ra-btn" type="button" data-go="vendor">Continue to the vendor assessment</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="print">Print or save as PDF</button><button class="ra-btn ghost" type="button" data-act="download">Download results</button><span class="ra-muted"><span class="ra-link" role="button" tabindex="0" data-go="ready">Change my readiness answers</span></span>';
 $('#ra-rnext').innerHTML=nx}
function showV(){var t=vTotal(),b=vBand(t),g=gated(),cs=catScores();
 $('#ra-vt').innerHTML=t+'<small> / 42</small>';
 $('#ra-vlab').textContent=(S.vname?S.vname+' \xB7 ':'')+TIERS[S.tier][0]+' risk tier';
 $('#ra-vband').textContent=g?'Disqualified at this risk tier':VB[b][0];
 $('#ra-vmsg').textContent=g?'The total does not matter: at '+TIERS[S.tier][0]+' risk, a low security or privacy score ends the conversation until the vendor fixes it in writing.':VB[b][1];
 $('#ra-vmark').style.left=(t/42*100)+'%';
 $('#ra-gate').innerHTML=S.tier>=2?(g?'<div class="ra-gate"><b>Gate \xB7 security and privacy</b>Q1 data use scored '+S.v[0]+' and Q2 PHI/PII security scored '+S.v[1]+'. At '+TIERS[S.tier][0]+' risk, either at 0 or 1 disqualifies the vendor. Ask for contract language on data use and training, a signed BAA and third-party audit reports, then rescore.</div>'
  :'<div class="ra-gate ra-ok"><b>Gate \xB7 passed</b>Security and privacy scores clear the bar for '+TIERS[S.tier][0]+' risk. Keep the evidence for both on file.</div>'):'';
